name: Execute
description: Nearby heroes take true damage equal to 16% missing Health; kills cut remaining cooldown by 90%.

name: Flash
description: Blink a short distance toward the chosen direction.

name: Frenzy
description: For 7s: damage +10%, Resistance +15%, Physical Lifesteal +20%, Magical Lifesteal +30%.

name: Heal
description: Restore 15% Health to nearby allies and self; nearby allies gain 15% Movement Speed for 2s.

name: Intimidate
description: For 4s: nearby enemy damage -25%, own damage reduction +20%; repeated allied uses weaken debuffs.

name: Purify
description: Clear debuffs except suppression; gain 1.5s control immunity.

name: Smite
description: Deal 1,500 true damage to a monster/minion; stun 1s. Jungle equipment upgrades it.

name: Sprint
description: Clear slows; Movement Speed +30% for 10s. Halve incoming slows; gain extra speed outside combat.

name: Teleport
description: Channel 2s to an allied structure/minion; cancellation or recent Portal use shortens cooldown.
